canonicalInstructionsUnchanged: Set a barbell in a rack near shoulder height. Take a grip just outside shoulder width, brace the trunk, and step back with the bar at the front of the shoulders.
Press overhead while keeping the ribs down and moving the head just enough to let the bar pass.
Lower to the front of the shoulders without leaning back, then return the bar to the rack after the set.
rationale: The first Graphic 3D motion and edited overhead anchor both retained an unclear far-elbow endpoint. The final starting-frame attempt removes image-pose bias by generating from text in a directly frontal view with both extended arms equally visible.

failedAnchor.observation: Near arm extends clearly, but far elbow remains visibly bent. This exact image must not pass the paid-motion gate.
